blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mounting foreign exchange losses and higher interest expenses hit DITO CME Holdings Corp. in the first nine months of 2026, during which its net loss attributable to shareholders ballooned to P17.1 billion. That marked a 77-percent jump from the attributable net loss of P9.65 billion in the same period last year.
